This is the homepage. New posts go in the `posts/` folder and appear here automatically.

## What you can write

- **`posts/*.qmd`** — plain Markdown posts (same `YYYY-MM-DD`-style frontmatter, folder-less)
- **`posts/*.ipynb`** — Jupyter notebooks, rendered natively (no conversion pipeline needed)
